subject: Anthropic prices its IPO well above the range, GTA VI reviews are in
notes: Issue body is dated Wed, Nov 18; sent 01:09 UTC on 19 Nov. Headlines only, no article text.

stories.headline: Anthropic prices upsized IPO at $83 per share, above the $70-$78 range, raising $81.3B
stories.quote: ANTHROPIC PRICES ITS UPSIZED IPO AT $83 PER SHARE, ABOVE THE $70-$78 MARKETED RANGE, RAISING $81.3B IN THE LARGEST OFFERING ON RECORD, TOPPING SPACEX

facts.text: Priced at $83 per share, above the marketed range of $70 to $78; raised $81.3B, described as the largest offering on record.
facts.quote: ANTHROPIC PRICES ITS UPSIZED IPO AT $83 PER SHARE, ABOVE THE $70-$78 MARKETED RANGE, RAISING $81.3B IN THE LARGEST OFFERING ON RECORD, TOPPING SPACEX

facts.text: Trading expected to begin on Nasdaq (ticker ANT) the day after pricing.
facts.quote: We've priced our IPO at $83 per share, with trading expected to begin on Nasdaq tomorrow.

facts.text: Per a post citing CNBC, the IPO attracted nearly $500 billion in orders: about $400 billion institutional and nearly $100 billion retail.
facts.quote: Anthropic's IPO has now attracted nearly $500 billion in investor orders, per CNBC. Institutional demand has reached ~$400 billion, while retail orders are approaching $100 billion.

facts.text: The initially planned raise was $64.4 billion.
facts.quote: Anthropic is also considering raising more than the initially planned $64.4 billion.

facts.text: A filing shows about $3B raised from Japanese investors as part of the IPO, the lower end of a planned $3B to $3.5B.
facts.quote: FILING: ANTHROPIC RAISED ~$3B FROM JAPANESE INVESTORS AS PART OF ITS IPO, THE LOWER END OF ITS PLANNED RANGE OF $3B TO $3.5B

facts.text: FT: the IPO is set to redraw VC power rankings, with lesser-known firms such as AMP PBC poised for outsized returns.
facts.quote: ANTHROPIC'S IPO IS SET TO REDRAW VC'S POWER RANKINGS, WITH LESSER-KNOWN FIRMS LIKE AMP PBC POISED FOR OUTSIZED RETURNS COMPARED WITH LARGER, BLUE-CHIP RIVALS

facts.text: Bloomberg analysis: at the IPO midpoint the average Anthropic employee's equity is valued at $72M.
facts.quote: AT ANTHROPIC'S IPO MIDPOINT, THE AVERAGE EMPLOYEE'S EQUITY IS VALUED AT $72M

facts.text: Masayoshi Son says passing on a 2023 opportunity to invest in Anthropic was a mistake.
facts.quote: MASAYOSHI SON SAYS PASSING ON A 2023 OPPORTUNITY TO INVEST IN ANTHROPIC WAS A “MISTAKE”, NOTING THAT “BY THAT POINT, WE HAD ALREADY DECIDED TO INVEST IN OPENAI”

stories.headline: Sources: Wall Street executives and the NSA told Congress this week's outages came from a rush to patch AI-found vulnerabilities
stories.quote: SOURCES: WALL STREET EXECS AND THE NSA TOLD CONGRESS THIS WEEK'S OUTAGES STEMMED FROM SYSTEMS OVERWHELMED BY A RUSH TO PATCH VULNERABILITIES FOUND BY AI MODELS

facts.text: DNI, DHS and FBI officials told Congress they found no evidence the outages were connected or caused by cyberattacks.
facts.quote: DNI, DHS, AND FBI OFFICIALS TELL CONGRESS THEY HAVE FOUND NO EVIDENCE THAT RECENT US TECH OUTAGES WERE CONNECTED TO EACH OTHER OR CAUSED BY CYBERATTACKS

facts.text: Marco Rubio says there is zero evidence linking the FAA ground stop, Microsoft outage and bank service issues.
facts.quote: MARCO RUBIO SAYS THERE'S “ZERO EVIDENCE” LINKING THE RECENT FAA GROUND STOP, MICROSOFT OUTAGE, AND BANK SERVICE ISSUES, AND THE US ISN'T “UNDER SYSTEMIC ATTACK”

stories.headline: Nvidia holds first all-hands since Jensen Huang's ouster; Colette Kress promises early raises and equity

facts.text: Sources: a faction of Nvidia's board is pushing for Huang's return although chair Harvey Jones said the board does not intend to reinstate him.
facts.quote: SOURCES: A FACTION OF NVIDIA'S BOARD MEMBERS IS PUSHING FOR JENSEN HUANG'S RETURN DESPITE CHAIR HARVEY JONES STATING THE BOARD DOESN'T INTEND TO REINSTATE HUANG

facts.text: Sources: Nvidia made two introductions in 2022 connecting Alibaba with alleged Chinese spy Alice Huang, helping Megaspeed land Alibaba as a customer.
facts.quote: SOURCES: NVIDIA MADE TWO SEPARATE INTRODUCTIONS IN 2022 CONNECTING ALIBABA WITH ALLEGED CHINESE SPY ALICE HUANG, HELPING MEGASPEED LAND ALIBABA AS A CUSTOMER
